verification.summary: Three focused Windows tests passed: clean and idempotent installation with paths containing spaces; upgrade, rollback, and uninstall; health and drift detection; missing dependency and tampered-package fail-closed behavior.

notes: Implemented a repository-backed Windows installation controller and health check with caller-declared targets, exact source and manifest digests, revision-bound receipts, idempotent reinstall, preserved upgrade backups, identity-correct rollback, uninstall, drift detection, dependency validation, and pre-effect tamper rejection. No public publication, silent global mutation, secret storage, approval, integration, or commit was performed.
